body:
- See also https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114990

I think this is a good addition, but personally, I think we shouldn't specify that it's SDL2 format specifically and link SDL2 documentation, since we're using SDL3. The format should be the same, but I feel like it could create confusion if we use SDL2 documentation while we're using SDL3.
What do you think? :)

(Also note that `Input.add_joy_mapping()` is currently a bit [broken](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/pull/11956) 😅 )
> Currently (more specifically, since Godot 4.5 when we integrated SDL) Godot's `Input.add_joy_mapping()` is broken, it will add a new mapping on top of an already existing mapping from SDL (if it exists), so I'm not sure it should be used as an example at the moment. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118606 for more information.

> I think we shouldn't specify that it's SDL2 format specifically and link SDL2 documentation, since we're using SDL3. The format should be the same, but I feel like it could create confusion if we use SDL2 documentation while we're using SDL3.
What do you think? :)

I definitely agree. As I was working on this PR, I admit I was confused by the docs saying "SDL2" despite knowing we had SDL3 under the hood. I just went with SDL2's docs since they were what the existing text stated.

Just using "SDL", and linking to the docs for SDL3, would make more sense if that lines up with how it actually works.

Regarding the state of `add_joy_mapping()` itself, the description you cited doesn't sound particularly bad to me. Perhaps the function's name could be more descriptive (something like `set_joy_mapping()` or `add_override_joy_mapping()`) but it generally makes sense to me that adding a mapping on top of an existing one would replace it.

---

It looks like the PR you linked is a superset of this PR's changes (especially the mapping format URL); if you agree then I can close this PR and make suggestions to your linked one for any potential additional changes instead 😄

> but it generally makes sense to me that adding a mapping on top of an existing one would replace it.

It does make sense, but currently Godot has its own mapping system (that was used prior to SDL integration) still builtin, just unused most of the time.
This builtin mapping system is the one that gets used for `Input.add_joy_mapping()`, so `Input.add_joy_mapping()` currently doesn't do anything on the SDL side.
Basically, it currently works like this:
Godot: "Oh, SDL provides input data to me, so I will treat it as raw data."
"Oh, the user called `Input.add_joy_mapping()`, so I should create a mapping for that raw data myself!"

But Godot's custom mapping system is not aware that SDL provides its own mapping system too.
If that makes sense 😅

Ah alright, I think I follow, thanks!

At any rate, since your PR includes this fix as well as other things, I don't think there's reason to keep this one open so I will close it for now 🙂
